warning.titlePre: Mercedes Citan 111 CDI Injector & EGR Issues
paragraphs: If your Citan 111 CDI is a W415 generation model with the K9K Renault-sourced diesel — that's the 2012 to 2021 production run — injector failure and EGR clogging are well-documented patterns on this engine, backed by general Renault/Mercedes commercial vehicle consensus. We replace injector seals, the EGR valve and timing chain components as standard on every K9K rebuild.
The newer W420 generation Citan doesn't use the K9K engine and falls outside this specific issue — it's covered separately if you have a later van.
warning.source: Source: general Renault/Mercedes commercial vehicle consensus, per VRF-mercedes-citan.md. W420 range explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF
